title: GRADIENT OF A VOLUME FILE
description: Computes the gradient of the volume by doing linear regressions for each voxel, considering only its face neighbors unless too few face neighbors exist.  The gradient vector is constructed from the partial derivatives of the resulting linear function, and the magnitude of this vector is the output.  If specified, the volume vector output is arranged with the x, y, and z components from a subvolume as consecutive subvolumes.

kernel.description: the size of the gaussian smoothing kernel in mm, as sigma by default

fwhm.description: kernel size is FWHM, not sigma

presmooth.description: smooth the volume before computing the gradient

roi.description: select a region of interest to take the gradient of

vector_volume_out.description: the vectors as a volume file

subvolume.description: select a single subvolume to take the gradient of
